blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del dur — A newly built P9.75-million evacuation center in Barangay Esperanza, Carmen, Surigao del Sur, has drawn scrutiny after portions of its exterior metal cladding collapsed before turnover, prompting calls for an immediate technical audit. The construction flaw came to light after resident Angel Montenegro Daray, whose home sits directly across the site, posted video footage showing sheets of exterior metal cladding peeled off and crumpled on the ground. According to Daray, the collapse occurred early Sunday morning in the absence of any severe weather disturbance or seismic activity. READ: Building collapse bad for nearby businesses “There […]...
